title: Containers
shortDescription: Manage Docker containers, Compose projects, images, volumes and networks without opening Docker Desktop or a terminal.
description:
Manage your Docker containers, Compose projects, images, volumes and networks from Command Palette, without opening Docker Desktop or a terminal.

- Containers: start, stop, restart, pause, resume, kill and remove, with live updates and All/Running/Stopped filters.
- Open a shell in a running container or follow its logs in your terminal.
- Open published ports in your browser, and copy a container's name, ID or IP address.
- Inspect a container: state, image, command, networks, mounts, environment and labels.
- Compose projects: up, start, stop, restart, pull, logs and down; open the project folder, editor or a terminal there.
- Images: run, pull latest, remove, and clean up dangling or unused images.
- Volumes and networks: browse, remove and clean up unused ones.
- System: engine version, disk usage, cleanup, and docker context switching.
- Find containers by name from the main Command Palette search.
- Start Docker Desktop from the extension when the engine isn't running.

Requires Docker Desktop or another Docker engine reachable over a named pipe or TCP. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Docker, Inc. Docker is a trademark of Docker, Inc.
